fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Playing the fool to face the shadow", "body": "Keith described how the wigs and the Flaccid Dick character began as a new look and turned into a way of studying a hidden side of himself. He said he disliked the figure he was making, then realized he was looking at his shadow, so he named it and kept going. He released seven short EPs over a year, three songs each, about a minute apiece. Chance read the project as the opposite of the cool persona most artists present, and the two compared it to the fool who stands close to the king."}, {"title": "Clown the crown and the magic of words", "body": "Chance opened with the episode title and the idea of clowning the crown, and Keith explained that his video condemning the monarchy was really about the words used to control people. The two enjoyed the lore and lure pairing and the L to R shift between the words, and stayed with word magic and the unsaid meaning inside what is written. Chance argued that people get lured into lore and chase side paths, and later said that seeing matter as spirit would undercut the divide the clown crowns have used to control people."}, {"title": "Art made from lineage, outside the culture", "body": "Keith wondered what it means to be an artist in relation to society, and whether he would still make art if society fell apart. He said talismans and totems were his answer. He showed totems cast from his grandfather's lead fishing weights and his own childhood model paint, which he wanted to be literal materials and not a metaphor. Chance said the pieces carried meaning from his real lineage, outside the larger culture. Keith said he tried to radiate from within into a culture that would easily swallow him."}, {"title": "Unschooling with care and labyrinth walks", "body": "Keith said his two children were homeschooled, a daughter who painted and a son who told stories, and that his approach was to teach critical thinking, reading and math, then let care drive the rest. Chance added that teaching communication and self love might be all a child needed. Keith said he skipped religion because of his Catholic upbringing, so the family kept a shrine, said short prayers and walked labyrinths found through the Labyrinth Locator website, using mantras like may all beings be happy."}, {"title": "Surrender, will, and flow", "body": "Keith contrasted the will to power with the will of the way, and said letting go of the self he had built was the hard part. Chance pulled two I Ching cards, Conflict and Influence, and read them as will versus deep flows and as the ground that lets many personas play. Gordy called in, said early psychedelic experiences cracked the shell of his ego, and described meditating under a tree of owls that followed him home. Chance later linked sorrow and joy, and Keith named frustration as his motivator and playing live as getting out of his own way."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Keith Gladysz is a musician and creator in many artistic mediums. In 2019 he came on InnerVerse to talk about how he overcame Lyme with Eastern Medicine and movement practices. Tonight we'll be talking about his creative journey in the last 2 years since returning to peak condition, and maybe talking about being a home-school dad. Expect dad-gags.
